description: Query W&B experiments, Weave traces, artifacts, registries, automations, and reports through the official W&B MCP server.

auth.label: W&B API Key
auth.description: A W&B API key sent to the MCP server as an Authorization Bearer token. Create or copy a key at https://wandb.ai/authorize.

extraFields.label: MCP Endpoint URL
extraFields.description: Optional full W&B MCP endpoint. Leave blank to use the hosted service for W&B Dedicated Cloud, or enter the /mcp URL of a separately deployed server for Self-Managed W&B. The hosted endpoint does not support W&B Multi-tenant Cloud.

actions.name: compare_artifact_versions
actions.description: Compare metadata, aliases, tags, lineage, sizes, and optionally files for two W&B artifact versions.

artifact_name_a.description: The first fully qualified artifact version name.

artifact_name_b.description: The second fully qualified artifact version name.

inputSchema.description: Input for comparing W&B artifact versions.

digest_match.description: Whether both artifact versions have the same digest.

outputSchema.description: A comparison of two W&B artifact versions.

actions.name: compare_runs
actions.description: Compare configuration, summary metrics, metadata, and optionally metric history for two W&B runs.

entity_name.description: The W&B entity or team name.

include_history_overlap.description: Whether to compare overlapping sampled metric history.

history_keys.description: Metric keys used for history comparison.

inputSchema.description: Input for comparing W&B runs.

run_a.description: Details for the first W&B run.

run_b.description: Details for the second W&B run.

outputSchema.description: A structured comparison of two W&B runs.

actions.name: count_weave_traces
actions.description: Count matching classic Weave traces and root traces without returning trace payloads.

entity_name.description: The W&B entity or team name.

inputSchema.description: Input for counting Weave traces.

root_traces_count.description: The number of matching root traces.

actions.name: create_report
actions.description: Create a W&B report with narrative text, plots, and configurable panels.

entity_name.description: The W&B entity or team name.

anyOf.description: Plotly HTML documents keyed by plot name.

plots_html.description: Plotly HTML supplied as one string or a name-to-HTML map.

inputSchema.description: Input for creating a W&B report.

outputSchema.description: A confirmation containing the saved W&B report URL.

actions.name: diagnose_run
actions.description: Inspect loss metrics and run state to diagnose the training health of a W&B run.

entity_name.description: The W&B entity or team name.

inputSchema.description: Input for diagnosing a W&B run.

actions.name: get_artifact_details
actions.description: Get metadata, lineage, and optionally files for a W&B artifact version.

artifact_name.description: The fully qualified artifact version name.

include_files.description: Whether to include artifact file entries.

max_files.description: Maximum files to return when file entries are included.

inputSchema.description: Input for reading a W&B artifact version.

actions.name: get_run_history
actions.description: Retrieve sampled time-series metric history for a W&B run.

entity_name.description: The W&B entity or team name.

inputSchema.description: Input for retrieving W&B run history.

keys_returned.description: Metric keys present in the result.

actions.name: infer_trace_schema
actions.description: Sample classic Weave traces to discover field paths, types, and frequent values.

entity_name.description: The W&B entity or team name.

inputSchema.description: Input for inferring a Weave trace schema.

actions.name: list_artifact_versions
actions.description: List versions of a W&B project artifact or registry collection.

entity_name.description: The W&B entity or team name.

source.description: Whether the collection belongs to a project or registry.

inputSchema.description: Input for listing W&B artifact versions.

outputSchema.description: Versions in a W&B artifact collection.

actions.name: list_automations
actions.description: List W&B Automations that trigger on artifact, run-state, or run-metric events.

inputSchema.description: Input for listing W&B Automations.

actions.name: list_entities
actions.description: List W&B user and team entities accessible with the configured API key.

inputSchema.description: No input is required.

actions.name: list_integrations
actions.description: List Slack and webhook integrations available as W&B Automation targets.

inputSchema.description: Input for listing W&B integrations.

actions.name: list_projects
actions.description: List W&B projects for one entity or for all entities accessible with the configured API key.

inputSchema.description: Input for listing W&B projects.

actions.name: list_registries
actions.description: List W&B model registries for an organization.

inputSchema.description: Input for listing W&B registries.

actions.name: list_registry_collections
actions.description: List artifact collections within a W&B model registry.

inputSchema.description: Input for listing W&B registry collections.

actions.name: log_analysis
actions.description: Log analysis rows, charts, and scalar metrics to W&B as a new run.

entity_name.description: The W&B entity or team name.

scalars.description: Scalar metrics keyed by metric name.

inputSchema.description: Input for logging an analysis run to W&B.

logged_keys.description: The logged metric and data keys.

row_count.description: The number of logged analysis rows.

outputSchema.description: The W&B run created for the analysis.

actions.name: probe_project
actions.description: Sample W&B runs to discover a project's metrics, configuration keys, tags, groups, and structure.

entity_name.description: The W&B entity or team name.

inputSchema.description: Input for probing a W&B project.

actions.name: query_wandb
actions.description: Run a read-only GraphQL query against W&B experiment data with bounded pagination.

max_items.description: Maximum total items returned across pages.

inputSchema.description: Input for querying W&B GraphQL data.

outputSchema.description: The W&B GraphQL response selected by the query.

actions.name: query_weave_traces
actions.description: Query classic Weave traces with filters, ordering, selected columns, cost data, feedback, and detail-level controls.

entity_name.description: The W&B entity or team name.

sort_by.description: The trace field used for sorting.

limit.description: The maximum number of traces to return.

include_costs.description: Whether to include calculated trace costs.

return_full_data.description: Whether to return untruncated trace data.

metadata_only.description: Whether to return query metadata without trace rows.

inputSchema.description: Input for querying Weave traces.

metadata.description: Trace query counts, distributions, time range, and truncation metadata.

outputSchema.description: Matching Weave traces and query metadata.

actions.name: resolve_trace_roots
actions.description: Resolve the root spans for a batch of classic Weave trace IDs.

entity_name.description: The W&B entity or team name.

inputSchema.description: Input for resolving Weave trace roots.

roots.description: Root span details keyed by requested trace ID.

resolved.description: The number of resolved trace IDs.

total_requested.description: The number of requested trace IDs.

actions.name: search_docs
actions.description: Search the official W&B documentation for relevant guidance and examples.

inputSchema.description: Input for searching W&B documentation.

outputSchema.description: Relevant excerpts from the official W&B documentation.

actions.name: summarize_evaluation
actions.description: Aggregate classic Weave evaluation results for a project or named evaluation.

entity_name.description: The W&B entity or team name.

inputSchema.description: Input for summarizing Weave evaluations.
